documentation.title: Removed declare encoding block mode
documentation.standard: Prior to PHP 8.7, it was possible to declare the encoding of a file using block mode when the file did not use a namespace. This wasn't working correctly and support for using block mode for encoding directives has been removed in PHP 8.7.

code.title: Cross-version compatible: declaring encoding as a stand-alone statement.
PHP < 8.7: declaring encoding using block mode.
